nodes.text: Today it is a particular fish, and a particular number of them. The board behind me says which. Bring them before the market closes.

choices.text: I will see what the board says.

nodes.text: Because that is what the tables want tonight. Tomorrow it will be another.
Fresh, mind. The board does not say stale.
All there, and still flapping. Tonight's tables will be pleased.
Here is your coin. Check the board again tomorrow.
